name: 46366 · North Judson, IN
findings: ZIP 46366 (North Judson) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 4 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 4 organizations.
75% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
